annotation.title_clean: Data protection safeguards are important for the safe implementation of the AI Act
annotation.title_en: Data protection safeguards are important for the safe implementation of the AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych (UODO, Personal Data Protection Office, Poland)
annotation.summary_en: News release from Poland's Personal Data Protection Office reporting President Mirosław Wróblewski's remarks to a Sejm AI subcommittee. He said much of the EU AI Act concerns processing personal data, and that GDPR principles must be upheld in practice. He also called for Data Protection Officers to be prepared for AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Large part of EU AI Act solutions relate to personal data processing, e.g. training data
Personal data protection is a fundamental right enshrined in the AI Act
Guaranteeing data protection will be a major challenge for DPAs
Data Protection Officers must be prepared for AI-related challenges
UODO offers expert support for future AI legislative work
